owner_decisions.outage_retry_and_missing_measurement_rul: Owner selected 2026-10-27: at most one documented infrastructure-only retry per step from its pre-attempt snapshot within the original aggregate time/credit allowance; log all attempts and charges, never retry poor outcomes. Retry infrastructure-failed measurement once on the same immutable snapshot; contradictory valid outcomes halt collection for oracle investigation. Exhausted/unrecoverable observations remain missing, never replacements. Owner approved prospective correction on 2026-10-28: positively established candidate-caused mandatory API/import, source-loader syntax or product exception nonpasses are failed outcomes with raw private provenance retained; true infrastructure, oracle and unclassified exceptions remain unknown. Both runners use the same policy. See protocol/prospective-corrections-2026-10-28.md; OSF recording is pending before affected collection.
owner_decisions.agent_failure_classification: Owner selected 2026-10-27: only documented terminal agent-caused inability makes unattempted CR1 unsuccessful; infrastructure, measurement failure or unresolved causes remain missing with bounds. Missing data alone do not prove agent failure.
owner_decisions.assisted_run_disposition_and_telemetry: Owner selected 2026-10-27: logged infrastructure administration only, no code fixes, task hints or design advice.
